Contact Me Profile Proven L&D leader with 10+ years of experience across startups and global orgs. Expert at designing and managing training programs grounded in Adult Learning Theory and data analysis. Experienced in developing high-performing teams, working cross-functionally, streamlining & standardizing processes, and managing/migrating learning technology platforms. Advocate for change, feedback, and an unwavering learner-focused culture. Experience Training & Enablement Manager <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> Pushpay (Fintech) 2024 - 2025 Built a comprehensive training & enablement program across the CS org. Scope included hard skills (software, processes) as well as soft skills. Serve as system admin for LMS, PM, and Sales Execution platforms. Establish culture of data-driven improvements across all L&D initiatives.
Manager of Customer Education <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> Esper (DevOps SaaS) 2022 - 2023 Led a team of Instructional Designers and Technical Writers; responsible for all training courses, videos & technical documentation across entire product lineup. Oversaw several technology projects from conception to delivery, including an AI chatbot, LMS implementation, knowledgebase migration, and CMS upgrade.
Global Training Lead <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> Tesla 2021 - 2022 Led global training programs across NA, EMEA, and APAC regions. Managed all aspects of both onboarding and ongoing training, including needs analysis, instructional design, facilitation, technical writing, LMS management, and data analysis. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to develop & deploy training materials and evaluate program effectiveness.
Enterprise Training Managing Editor <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> Protective 2019 - 2020 Drove strategy, design, and technology for training programs spanning 10+ departments. Established and coached on classroom and virtual training standards. Oversaw migrations of LMS and PM (Workday) platforms.
Learning Architect <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> Daxko (SaaS) 2015 - 2019 Designed and implemented a company-wide onboarding training program for Services division. Led revamp of all external training programs; established KPIs for measuring learning, increased ROI, and improved organizational scalability. Led a company-wide merger of LMS platforms. Trained 1,500+ learners with 9+ NPS and tied to $1.75M in ARR. (Previous Roles: Training Team Manager, Software Trainer)
Creative (Technology Trainer) Apple 2011 - 2015 Piloted and shaped global internal retail onboarding program. Developed and coordinated all aspects of in-store internal training across several hardware and software launches. (Previous Roles: Global In-Store Guest Trainer, Mobile Device Technician) Education B.S.
